title: Office
intro: Office floor plan: open a desk to see its devices, cables and adapters.
adminsOnlyHint: To open it for everyone: set the Convex env OFFICE_MODE=live and add /office to OPEN_PREFIXES.

plan.editHint: Drag to move, bottom-right corner to resize. Names can be moved on their own. Walls/doors: drag the ends. 10 cm grid.
plan.empty: No floor plan yet. Tap “Edit floor plan” and draw the rooms and desks.
plan.selectHint: Tap something on the plan to edit it.
plan.kitchenBanner: {name} is in charge of the kitchen!

sizeDialog.title: Office size
sizeDialog.description: Outer dimensions of the office in centimetres.

deskDialog.title: Desk
deskDialog.name: Name on the plan
deskDialog.nameHint: Left as P1, P2 …, the plan shows the person's first name. Otherwise what you enter here – e.g. "Alex". With no person and a name of its own (e.g. "Meeting room") it's an equipment spot instead of "free".

removeDesk.title: Remove desk?
removeDesk.description: “{name}” disappears from the plan. Everything set up there goes to storage.

moveDialog.title: Move
moveDialog.description: “{name}” to a desk or to storage.

pickDialog.title: Take from storage
pickDialog.description: Set up a part from storage at “{place}”.

storage.intro: Everything not set up at a desk right now.

qr.title: Desk QR labels
qr.notice: Stick on the desk. Scan with a phone to record its equipment.
qr.dialogDescription: One label per desk. Scanning it opens the desk in the intranet.

ai.title: Record with AI
ai.description: Take photos and/or say what's there – the AI suggests a list for “{place}”.
ai.textPlaceholder: What's there? e.g. “two Dell monitors, a Lenovo dock, three HDMI cables” – on a phone, tap the keyboard's microphone and speak.
ai.hint: Up to 6 photos. Make plugs and printed labels visible. Photos are sent to the AI only to recognise them and are not stored.
ai.nothing: Nothing recognised – try another photo or a short description.
ai.review: Check the suggestion: untick anything that's wrong, adjust names and details.
ai.save: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing selected} one {Save 1 item} other {Save # items}}
ai.saved: {count, plural, one {1 item saved} other {# items saved}} – on to the next.

import.title: Import an inventory list
import.description: Bring storage and all desks in at once from an inventory list (JSON). Check first, then import.
import.readError: This file doesn't fit – an inventory list in JSON format is expected.
import.storageRows: Storage: {rows, plural, one {1 row} other {# rows}} ({count} parts)
import.deskNotEmpty: {count, plural, one {1 part is} other {# parts are}} already recorded at this desk
import.storageNotEmpty: {count, plural, one {1 part is} other {# parts are}} already in storage. The import only adds – retire anything imported twice by hand.
import.skipped: {count, plural, one {1 block is} other {# blocks are}} not imported – pick a desk above.
import.doubled: Several blocks go to the same desk.
import.run: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to import} one {Import 1 row} other {Import # rows}}
import.done: {count, plural, one {1 row} other {# rows}} imported.
